id: Passage syntax: Section 3.1 membership and natural codes
note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved only from ZInQ.SixContactMin and ZInQ.Translation.MultiplicationExact (itself proved only from ZInQ.SixContactMin, ZInQ.PoleCompleteness and ZInQ.Mult.SlopeRepresentation); ZInQ.Syntax.rawAddFormula a definition: rel_member_iff (and rel_member_iff_iota) is the all-input membership statement for 2E(K0), proved; rel_rawAdd_iota is the raw addition contract on canonical codes, proved. The multiplication soundness (multiply_sound) is conditional on the assumed ZInQ.SixContactMin, and natural_rel_iff (Rel_natural iff iota(N), by Lagrange) is conditional on MultiplicationExact, as [M] says.

noncomputable def rawAddFormula (p q r : Code) (mg md : Pair) (ug ud : ℕ) : Formula :=
  let both : Formula := .and [fin p, fin q]
  .or [.and [isO p, peq q r],
    .and [fin p, isO q, peq p r],
    .and [both, feq p.x q.x, feq p.y q.y.neg, isO r],
    .and [both, nzFormula (q.x.sub p.x).norm ug, feq ((q.x.sub p.x).mul mg) (q.y.sub p.y),
      addOut r p.x p.y q.x mg],
    .and [both, feq p.x q.x, feq p.y q.y, nzFormula p.y.norm ud,
      feq ((Pair.smul 2 p.y).mul md) ((Pair.smul 3 p.x.sq).add Pair.A), addOut r p.x p.y q.x md]]

verdicts.summary: [N] nasqret/z-in-q-lean states a different claim; neither implies the other (differs).
evidence: rel_member_iff, rel_member_iff_iota and rel_rawAdd_iota are proved with no hypotheses and match [M]. multiply_sound (hH : SixContactMin) and natural_rel_iff (hM : MultiplicationExact) concern multiplyTemplate and naturalTemplate, which embed poleTemplate with x+l, so they are statements about other polynomials. Grep confirms [N] names only MultiplicationExact among these.

ndep's Membership.lean and RawAddition.lean are byte-identical to [F]'s (diff), and rel_member_iff and rel_rawAdd_iota state [M]'s membership and raw-addition contracts; but multiply_sound (under SixContactMin) and natural_rel_iff (under MultiplicationExact) concern ndep's multiplyTemplate, whose slope tests call the Route K poleTemplate. nasqret has no membership, raw-addition or natural-predicate declaration of its own (name search and grep), and uses only MultiplicationExact.
